meta.title: 4o4 Instance
meta.author: MaV
meta.description: The soundtrack of 4o4 Instance by MaV (2026-04-05). Executable music that placed 2nd in the executable music competition at Revision 2026. 139 BPM, 4:00, 24 tracks, 6063 notes. Instruments: 9 Falcon (FM synth), 6 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 4 Thunder (GSM sample player), 2 Adultery (GM.DLS sampler), 1 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 8 Scissor, 7 Leveller, 1 Crusher, 11 Echo, 23 Smasher, 9 Chamber, 5 Cathedral. Its Adultery instruments play waves from the Windows GM.DLS bank: they sound as intended only with that bank (GM_DLS=<path to gm.dls>); macOS's own GS bank has other waves. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.05 dB loudness and at most 0.26 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
